component.name: SliceCraft
component.summary: Slice 3D models into G-code for your printer

description.p: SliceCraft turns STL, OBJ and 3MF models into G-code for FDM printers: place models on the plate, choose a profile, slice and check the toolpath preview layer by layer.
It also has a command-line tool and an MCP server, so scripts and agents can slice without the window.
